decisions.evidence: Rule already pairs acetolactate synthase subunits as AND-complexes (HP15_531 large + HP15_532 regulatory subunit; HP15_1017 large + HP15_1016 'ALS II small subunit-like'); two isozyme complexes, nothing to join or remove.

Outer-membrane diffusion step; both alternatives are OmpA-family envelope proteins (HP15_2834 'OmpA/MotB domain protein', HP15_p187g137 'outer membrane protein OprF'). Porin redundancy is expected and removal would leave a single OmpA-family gene, so no change.

HP15_3288 'anthranilate synthase component I' + HP15_3289 'anthranilate synthase glutamine amidotransferase component II' (TrpE/TrpG, in trpE-trpG-trpD-trpC cluster) form the enzyme; HP15_2338 'peptidase C26' (gamma-glutamyl-GABA hydrolase family) listed alone lacks the chorismate-aminating TrpE component and has a different activity.
HP15_1914 and HP15_p187g60 are both 'asparagine synthase, glutamine-hydrolyzing' (same-name paralogs).
HP15_1320 'aspartate kinase, monofunctional class' and HP15_3856 'aspartokinase' (ectoine cluster) are same-function paralogs.

Kept the three genes annotated 'aspartate aminotransferase' (HP15_814, HP15_858, HP15_1371); removed HP15_1649, HP15_1036 and HP15_2761, which are GntR/MocR-family transcriptional regulators (~470 aa; HP15_2761 = PdxR) whose aminotransferase-like domain is an effector domain.
